routes.title: Magic Internet Frens — 2222 Pixel Wizards, Fully On-Chain
routes.description: Magic Internet Frens (MiFrens): 2222 hand-crafted pixel wizards summoned fully on-chain. Home of The Cauldron — an eternal, autonomous token machine.

routes.name: The Cauldron
routes.title: Magic Internet Frens: The Cauldron
routes.description: An eternal, autonomous token machine on Uniswap v4. Each iteration lives, trades and is reborn by MiFren-holder governance, funded by its own swap fees.

routes.name: Mi Frens
routes.title: Magic Internet Frens: Mi Frens
routes.description: 1111 genesis pixel wizards, knights, gnomes and degens. Every genesis fren earns a perpetual share of Cauldron fees and holds a live redemption floor.

routes.name: The Token
routes.title: Magic Internet Frens: The Token
routes.description: 777,000,000 fixed supply per iteration — non-mintable, non-freezable, no team allocation. Holders migrate 1:1 into each new iteration by burning the old.

routes.name: About
routes.title: Magic Internet Frens: How It Works
routes.description: Every mechanic in one place: the fee split, gacha odds, perps and liquidation, governance, the genesis redemption floor, and the rebirth lifecycle.
